title: cargo terse fmt --fix is broken
description: runner.rs:27-39 detects --fix and skips adding --check, but still passes --fix through to cargo fmt which doesn't accept it. Either strip --fix from cargo_args, or remove the feature since cargo fmt formats in place by default.

title: fmt output ignores format flag
description: runner.rs run_fmt_output always prints plain text regardless of --format. cargo terse --format json fmt produces plain text. The formatter parameter is received but explicitly ignored.

title: Potential panic with NaN in JSON and TOON formatters
description: serde_json::Number::from_f64(elapsed_secs).unwrap() panics on NaN or infinity. Replace with fallback.

title: Missing test for TOON format_test_failure
description: toon.rs has no unit test for format_test_failure. Both plain.rs and json.rs have tests for this method.

title: detail command does not work for test failure IDs
description: cargo terse detail F1 returns no cached diagnostic because lookup_diagnostic in cache.rs only searches compiler diagnostics, not test results. Test failure IDs (F1, F2) are in the cache but unreachable via detail.

title: cargo terse watch: live diagnostic workspace with stable IDs
description: Persistent watch mode that re-runs on file save and maintains a rolling diagnostic map across rebuilds. Diagnostics that persist keep stable IDs (W1 stays W1). Fixed diagnostics disappear. New ones appear. Turns cargo-terse from a better pipe into a diagnostic database that AI agents can query without re-running builds. Enables a fundamentally better agentic workflow: check the map, pick highest-priority unfixed diagnostic, fix it, watch it disappear. Agent never waits for a build or parses stale output, and can reason about trends.

title: CI only tests on Linux
description: ci.yml only runs on ubuntu-latest but release builds for macOS and Windows. fmt.rs:65 assumes newline line endings.

title: No progress indicator during compilation
description: In terse mode there is no output while compiling. Add a simple single-line initial message so the user knows something is happening.

title: README should acknowledge message-format short and position differentiators
description: cargo check --message-format=short exists since 2018. README should acknowledge this and frame cargo-terse as building beyond it. Also mention RTK. Lead with drill-down as strongest differentiator.

title: Cargo.toml missing exclude for publishing
description: Internal design docs (docs/plans/) and .github/ would be published to crates.io. Add exclude to Cargo.toml.

title: Consider removing cargo terse fmt
description: cargo fmt output is already minimal and does the work directly. Wrapping it adds complexity (broken --fix, ignored --format flag, custom diff parsing) for little value. Consider dropping fmt support entirely, or at minimum demoting it to unsupported/undocumented. Would also clean up the fmt-related bugs (cargo-terse-0xg, cargo-terse-6s0).

title: Add rust-version MSRV to Cargo.toml
description: No rust-version field. Users won't know minimum supported Rust version.

title: --version scans past -- separator
description: main.rs args.iter().any scans all args including after --. Same bug fixed for --help. Move into parse_args.

title: cargo terse setup: auto-configure AI agent instructions
description: Add a setup subcommand that appends cargo-terse usage instructions to AI agent config files. Should be idempotent (detect if instructions already present). Features: (1) Project-level by default (CLAUDE.md in current dir or project root), (2) --global flag for user-level config (~/.claude/CLAUDE.md), (3) Support for multiple agent formats: CLAUDE.md (Claude Code), AGENTS.md, .cursorrules (Cursor), .github/copilot-instructions.md (Copilot), etc. Auto-detect which files exist, or accept --agent flag to specify. Print what it did.

title: Terse-specific flags after subcommand silently fail
description: cargo terse check --format json passes --format json to cargo instead of using it. Once check is parsed as subcommand, parser.raw_args() consumes everything as passthrough.

title: Dead code in parser.rs and plain.rs
description: parser.rs:35 unreachable match arm. plain.rs:97 unreachable fmt branch in format_summary, also hardcodes 0 files changed.

title: Misleading comment about -vv parsing in cli.rs
description: cli.rs:100-103 comment implies special handling that isn't there. Clean up or remove.

title: Cargo stderr is silently swallowed
description: runner.rs:99-100 captures stderr then discards it. cargo terse foobar shows '0 warnings, 0 errors' instead of cargo's error message. At minimum, forward stderr when exit code is non-zero and no diagnostics were parsed.
